title: Expression Language and JNDI Injection
platform_conditions: Java SE 8+ standard library (javax.naming, javax.script); servlet/EL behavior assumes Java EE or Jakarta EE containers
security_mechanism: InitialContext.lookup resolves a URL-scheme name (ldap://, rmi://, dns://) against remote directories; a JNDI endpoint the attacker chooses can return a Reference whose factory class the client loads and instantiates, turning the lookup string into remote code execution on vulnerable JDK builds and object fabrication on patched ones. Expression-Language evaluators (javax.el) and script engines (javax.script.ScriptEngine.eval, e.g. Nashorn) execute the attacker's expression with access to Java objects, method invocation and reflection included, so the string is code, not data.

source_sink_clues.source: Request fields reaching lookup keys, EL expressions built from user values (message templates, sorting, rules engines), and script strings handed to ScriptEngine.eval.
source_sink_clues.sink: InitialContext.lookup(userInput) and variants of javax.naming.Context methods; ValueExpression/ELProcessor.eval with dynamic expressions; ScriptEngine.eval on attacker-influenced strings

tracking_guards: Check the lookup name against a strict scheme and path allowlist before the call, and require the JNDI client disable remote codebase loading (com.sun.jndi.ldap.object.trustURLCodebase=false, the JDK default since late 2018, plus RMI equivalents); for EL and script engines require the expression come from fixed templates with only validated values substituted.
not_candidate_when: The lookup name is a compile-time constant or matched against a fixed allowlist, the naming provider is local-only with remote codebase loading disabled and reference factories restricted, or the EL/script input is a validated value substituted into a constant expression, never the expression text itself.
public_references: CWE-917: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/917.html
CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection') — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/74.html
